name: Lisa Malkie Vider
bottom_line: A first-time candidate's biography plus a pitch about serving in the majority. The biography matches press profiles. Her health-spending statistic is roughly right only on one budget measure.
findings: JNS's profile matches her Brooklyn upbringing, family and healthcare work.
Health care's share of the state budget depends on the measure: Medicaid is about 27–29% of state operating funds, while the Health Department's all-funds appropriation is about 43% of the budget.
page_issues: "Over 44%" is stated without a source or a definition.
